preview_release_notes:
## What's new in v1.0.0 - The Preview Update

## New

- Revamped the Check for Updates modal with structured release notes
- Added screen reader announcements with an Accessibility settings tab

## Fixes

- Fixed a crash when switching workspaces with pinned projects
- Fixed update checks failing silently when GitHub rate limits are hit

## Improvements

- Faster startup times across all platforms
- Reworked workspace modals with compact style pickers

## Known Issues

- Linux OS: AppImage won't work on some distros, use the .rpm or .deb package instead
- Windows: the taskbar may briefly show a duplicate icon until the app restarts

project_doctor.title: Project Doctor
project_doctor.local_checks: Checks run locally. Fixes to settings save a backup first.
project_doctor.templates_downloading: Downloading selected templates. Progress and cancellation are also available in Tasks.
project_doctor.version_queued: Engine download queued. Follow its progress in Tasks.
project_doctor.version_asset_unavailable: No matching download was found for this version and platform. Open Versions to install or locate the engine.
project_doctor.confirm_clear_cache: Move this project's .godot folder to the system Trash? Close the project in Godot first. Godot will reimport assets and rebuild editor state the next time it opens.
project_doctor.confirm_enable_addon: Enable this editor addon? Its script will run the next time you open the project in Godot. A backup of project.godot is saved first.
project_doctor.confirm_untrack_metadata: Remove .godothub.json from Git's index while keeping your local file? This stages its removal for your next commit. Existing commits and history stay unchanged.
project_doctor.confirm_track_lfs: Add a Git LFS rule for this file? Git LFS must be installed. This changes .gitattributes; re-add the file in Git to convert its next revision. Existing history stays unchanged.
project_doctor.confirm_remove_registration: Remove this library registration? Project files stay on disk. The registry is backed up first, and you can import the folder again.
project_doctor.version_unbound_description: Choose an installed engine to open and run this project.
project_doctor.version_missing_title: The bound engine is not installed
project_doctor.version_missing_description: This project is bound to {{version}}, but that version is absent from the installed engine registry.
project_doctor.version_executable_missing_description: {{version}} is registered, but its executable is no longer on disk. Locate or reinstall it in Versions.
project_doctor.version_ready_description: {{version}} is installed and its executable exists.
project_doctor.format_incompatible_description: config_version={{format}} cannot be opened by the bound {{version}} engine. Choose a compatible engine and use Godot's migration tools if needed.
project_doctor.major_mismatch_title: The project and engine use different Godot generations
project_doctor.major_mismatch_description: This project records a Godot {{major}} format but is bound to {{version}}. Choose a matching engine or migrate the project in Godot.
project_doctor.feature_mismatch_title: The recorded project version differs from its engine
project_doctor.feature_mismatch_description: The project records Godot {{recorded}} features but is bound to {{version}}. Match the binding or open it in the intended engine and review its upgrade changes.
project_doctor.format_unknown_title: The project version could not be confirmed
project_doctor.format_unknown_description: The project format or engine version is missing or unrecognized. Review project.godot before changing engine generations.
project_doctor.format_ready_title: The recorded format matches the bound engine
project_doctor.format_ready_description: The project format and recorded Godot feature version are compatible with this binding.
project_doctor.templates_platforms_missing_title: Some export targets have no installed templates
project_doctor.templates_platforms_missing_description: These platforms appear in your export presets but have no templates installed for the bound engine. Choose the template files you need.
project_doctor.templates_missing_description: No installed export-template platform was found for {{version}}. Choose the platforms and files you need.
project_doctor.templates_ready_description: These platforms have installed templates for the bound engine. Open the chooser to review individual files.
project_doctor.templates_unknown_title: Install or bind the engine before checking templates
project_doctor.templates_unknown_description: Export templates must match the exact engine version, including standard or .NET builds.
project_doctor.main_scene_ready_description: The project has an application/run/main_scene setting.
project_doctor.main_scene_missing_description: Open the project in Godot and choose a main scene in Project Settings before running the game.
project_doctor.main_scene_missing_file_title: The main scene file is missing
project_doctor.main_scene_missing_file_description: The configured scene path does not exist. Choose an existing main scene in Godot.
project_doctor.cache_ready_title: The import cache is within normal limits
project_doctor.cache_ready_description: {{size}} across {{files}} files. Last cache write: {{days}} days ago.
project_doctor.cache_large_title: The import cache uses significant disk space
project_doctor.cache_large_description: {{size}} across {{files}} files. Large projects can need a large cache; clearing it causes a full reimport.
project_doctor.cache_stale_title: The import cache has not changed recently
project_doctor.cache_stale_description: {{size}} across {{files}} files; last write was {{days}} days ago. Age alone does not mean the cache is broken.
project_doctor.cache_version_title: The cache records a different engine executable
project_doctor.cache_version_description: The editor cache was last associated with a different engine path. If imports misbehave, rebuild its {{size}} cache.
project_doctor.cache_partial_description: At least {{size}} across {{files}} files. Some entries were unreadable or the scan reached its time or file limit.
project_doctor.cache_absent_description: Godot 4 creates this folder when the project opens. Godot 3 uses a different cache layout.
project_doctor.addon_missing_title: An enabled editor addon is missing
project_doctor.addon_missing_description: This editor_plugins entry has no plugin.cfg on disk. Restore the addon or remove the stale enabled entry.
project_doctor.addon_disabled_title: An editor addon is present but disabled
project_doctor.addon_disabled_description: Its plugin.cfg is on disk but not listed in editor_plugins. This can be intentional. Enable it only if you want its editor functionality.
project_doctor.addon_orphan_title: An addon folder has no editor plugin configuration
project_doctor.addon_orphan_description: This folder is not an enabled editor addon. It may be a runtime library or leftover files; review it before removing anything.
project_doctor.addons_ready_title: Enabled editor addons exist on disk
project_doctor.addons_ready_description: No missing or disabled editor-plugin folders were found.
project_doctor.no_presets_description: Create export presets in Godot when you are ready to package the project.
project_doctor.presets_unreadable_title: Export presets could not be read
project_doctor.presets_unreadable_description: Review export_presets.cfg and run the checks again.
project_doctor.exports_ready_description: Explicit res:// references in the export presets exist on disk. Wildcard filters and output paths are excluded from this check.
project_doctor.export_resources_missing_description: Restore these files or update the references in Godot's export settings or export_presets.cfg.
project_doctor.git_unavailable_description: This folder is not in a Git repository, Git is unavailable, or the repository could not be inspected.
project_doctor.ignore_missing_title: Generated or local files are not ignored
project_doctor.ignore_missing_description: The effective Git ignore rules do not cover all of .godot/, .godothub/, and .godothub.json. Add project-local rules to keep them out of future commits.
project_doctor.ignores_ready_title: Generated and local files are ignored
project_doctor.ignores_ready_description: Git ignores the import cache and local GodotHub metadata.
project_doctor.metadata_tracked_title: Local GodotHub metadata is tracked by Git
project_doctor.metadata_tracked_description: .godothub.json is in Git's index, so ignore rules alone will not keep it out of commits. Remove it from tracking while keeping the local file.
project_doctor.metadata_private_title: Legacy local metadata is not tracked
project_doctor.metadata_private_description: .godothub.json is absent from Git's tracked-file index.
project_doctor.lfs_ready_title: No large binaries need a Git LFS rule
project_doctor.lfs_ready_description: Scanned binary files of 50 MiB or more are ignored by Git or covered by an LFS filter rule. Existing commit history is not inspected.
project_doctor.lfs_unknown_title: Git LFS attributes could not be checked
project_doctor.lfs_unknown_description: Review the Git error below, then run the checks again.
project_doctor.binary_without_lfs_title: A large binary has no Git LFS rule
project_doctor.binary_without_lfs_description: This binary is at least 50 MiB and is not ignored or covered by filter=lfs. Track it with LFS to keep future revisions out of regular Git blobs.
project_doctor.scan_partial_title: The project file scan was incomplete
project_doctor.scan_partial_description: Some paths were unreadable or the scan reached its 50,000-entry or five-second limit. Large-binary results may be incomplete.
project_doctor.registration_stale_title: This registration no longer points to a project
project_doctor.registration_stale_description: No project.godot was found at this path. Reconnect moved or offline storage, or remove the stale library entry.
project_doctor.registration_duplicate_title: Another registration points to this project
project_doctor.registration_duplicate_description: This additional library entry resolves to the same project folder or a stale copy of its identity. Remove it to keep the current registration.
project_doctor.registration_ready_description: This project has one valid folder registration in the active workspace.
